entities.summary: Ana Rosa Tornero de Bilbao La Vieja, (1907–1984) was a Bolivian writer, journalist, teacher, social reformer and a feminist activist. She published the first feminist magazine in Bolivia and was one of the founders of the first feminist organization in the country.
